scripts.build:check: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html','utf8');const h1=h.match(/<h1/g)||[];const pr=h.match(/data-prerendered/g)||[];if(h1.length<1){console.error('FAIL: No <h1> found');process.exit(1);}if(pr.length<1){console.error('FAIL: data-prerendered not found');process.exit(1);}console.log('OK: <h1> count='+h1.length+', data-prerendered count='+pr.length);"
